_meta.naming_note: Renamed 2026-07-10 (migration d5f7a9c1e3b5) — the table name IS the Amazon report type.
_meta.description: FBA removal SHIPMENT events: what physically left the fulfilment centre against a removal order, with carrier and tracking. The sibling rpt_get_fba_fulfillment_removal_order_detail_data holds the ORDER side — requested vs cancelled vs disposed quantities. Join them on order_id to reconcile requested against shipped.
_meta.date_column_note: Nullable in schema; 0 NULL rows of 601 live on prod (measured 2026-08-23). Amazon omits shipment-date only on rows that never shipped, and those do not reach this report — the column stays nullable for legacy compat, not because the parser skips it.
